Profile Methoprene is an insect growth regulator which mimics the ac- tion of insect juvenile hormones and, if it is applied at the appro- priate period of sensitivity, it causes death by preventing the transformation of larva to pupa. It is used against a variety of insects including fleas and mosquitoes. It is used in veterinary practice for the control of ectoparasites in the environment, rath- er than being applied to the animals themselves. It is also used in agriculture.
